arxiv-2107-09323.title: Transfer Learning for Credit Card Fraud Detection: A Journey from Research to Production
arxiv-2107-09323.creator: Wissam Siblini, Guillaume Coter, Rémy Fabry Liyun He-Guelton & Frédéric Oblé, Bertrand Lebichot, Yann-Aël Le Borgne & Gianluca Bontempi
arxiv-2107-09323.description: Abstract The dark face of digital commerce generalization is the increase of fraud attempts. To prevent any type of attacks, state-of-the-art fraud detection systems are now embedding Machine Learning (ML) modules. The conception of such modules is only communicated at the level of research and papers mostly focus on results for isolated benchmark datasets and metrics.

arxiv-2112-10868.title: Self-testing of multipartite GHZ states of arbitrary local dimension with arbitrary number of measurements per party
arxiv-2112-10868.creator: Shubhayan Sarkar, Remigiusz Augusiak
arxiv-2112-10868.description: Abstract Device independent certification schemes have gained a lot of interest lately, not only for their applications in quantum information tasks but also their implications towards foundations of quantum theory. The strongest form of device independent certification, known as self-testing, often requires for a Bell inequality to be maximally violated by specific quantum states and measurements.

arxiv-2205-03067.title: Translating Place-Related Questions to GeoSPARQL Queries
arxiv-2205-03067.creator: Ehsan Hamzei, Martin Tomko, Stephan Winter
arxiv-2205-03067.description: Abstract Many place-related questions can only be answered by complex spatial reasoning, a task poorly supported by factoid question retrieval. Such reasoning using combinations of spatial and non-spatial criteria pertinent to place-related questions is increasingly possible on linked data knowledge bases.

arxiv-2210-08419.title: Mass-dependent transport of hadron species from soft to hard (nonjet to jet) spectrum components within small collision systems at the large hadron collider Preprint: version 0.4
arxiv-2210-08419.creator: Thomas A. Trainor
arxiv-2210-08419.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Thomas A. Trainor. In previous analyses a two-component (soft+hard) model (TCM) was developed for identified-hadron (PID) spectra from 5 TeV p p -Pb and 13 TeV p p - p p collisions. Spectrum data are generally described within their statistical uncertainties.

arxiv-2306-07818.title: A Primal-Dual-Critic Algorithm for Offline Constrained Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2306-07818.creator: Kihyuk Hong, Yuhang Li, Ambuj Tewari
arxiv-2306-07818.description: Abstract Offline constrained reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn a policy that maximizes the expected cumulative reward subject to constraints on expected cumulative cost using an existing dataset. In this paper, we propose Primal-Dual-Critic Algorithm (PDCA), a novel algorithm for offline constrained RL with general function approximation. PDCA runs a primal-dual algorithm on the Lagrangian function estimated by critics.

arxiv-2407-15385.title: Towards Robust Vision Transformer via Masked Adaptive Ensemble
arxiv-2407-15385.creator: Fudong Lin, Jiadong Lou, Xu Yuan, Nian-Feng Tzeng
arxiv-2407-15385.description: Abstract . Adversarial training (AT) can help improve the robustness of Vision Transformers (ViT) against adversarial attacks by intentionally injecting adversarial examples into the training data. However, this way of adversarial injection inevitably incurs standard accuracy degradation to some extent, thereby calling for a trade-off between standard accuracy and adversarial robustness.

arxiv-2503-15551.title: Efficient but Vulnerable: Benchmarking and Defending LLM Batch Prompting Attack
arxiv-2503-15551.creator: Murong Yue, Ziyu Yao
arxiv-2503-15551.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Murong Yue, Ziyu Yao. Batch prompting, which combines a batch of multiple queries sharing the same context in one inference, has emerged as a promising solution to reduce inference costs. However, our study reveals a significant security vulnerability in batch prompting: malicious users can inject attack instructions into a batch, leading to unwanted interference across all queries, which can result in the inclusion of harmful content, such as phishing links, or the disruption of logical reasoning.

arxiv-2504-14335.title: Visual Prompting for One-shot Controllable Video Editing without Inversion
arxiv-2504-14335.creator: Zhengbo Zhang, Yuxi Zhou, Duo Peng, Joo-Hwee Lim, Zhigang Tu, De Wen Soh, Lin Geng Foo
arxiv-2504-14335.description: Abstract One-shot controllable video editing (OCVE) is an important yet challenging task, aiming to propagate user edits that are made – using any image editing tool – on the first frame of a video to all subsequent frames, while ensuring content consistency between edited frames and source frames.

arxiv-2509-04418.title: The influence of the Casimir effect on the binding potential for 3D wetting
arxiv-2509-04418.creator: Alessio Squarcini, José M. Romero-Enrique, Andrew O. Parry
arxiv-2509-04418.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alessio Squarcini, José M. Romero-Enrique, Andrew O. Parry. We provide comprehensive details of how a previously overlooked entropic, or low temperature Casimir contribution, W C W_{C} , to the total binding potential for 3D short-ranged wetting may be determined from a microscopic Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson Hamiltonian. The entropic contribution comes from the many microscopic configurations corresponding to a given interfacial one, which arise from bulk-like fluctuations about the mean-field (MF) constrained profile, and adds to the usual MF contribution W M ​ F W_{MF} .

arxiv-2601-06547.title: Sign Accuracy, Mean-Squared Error and the Rate of Zero Crossings: a Generalized Forecast Approach
arxiv-2601-06547.creator: Marc Wildi
arxiv-2601-06547.description: Abstract Forecasting entails a complex estimation challenge, as it requires balancing multiple, often conflicting, priorities and objectives. Traditional forecast optimization criteria typically focus on a single metric—such as minimizing the mean squared error (MSE)—which may overlook other important aspects of predictive performance.

pmc-10560833.title: Unravelling the dynamics of human development and economic growth on crude oil production based on ARDL and NARDL models
pmc-10560833.creator: Jean Marie Stevy Sama, Flavian Emmanuel Sapnken, Inoussah Moungnutou Mfetoum, Jean Gaston Tamba
pmc-10560833.description: This paper estimates and establishes the causality between the Human Development Index (HDI), Gross Domestic Product (GDP), inflation and CO2 emissions on crude oil production (COP) in Cameroon from 1977 to 2019. To do so, the Augmented Dicky-Fuller and Zivot-Andrews stationarity tests, ARDL and NARDL modelling, as well as Toda-Yamamoto causality test are performed.

pmc-11360845.description: The epidemic diseases such as COVID-19 are rapidly spreading all around the world. The diagnosis of epidemic at initial stage is of high importance to provide medical care to and recovery of infected people as well as protecting the uninfected population.

pmc-11585565.title: Functional and pathogenic insights into CNNM4 variants in Jalili syndrome
pmc-11585565.creator: Khanti Rattanapornsompong, Mawika Rinkrathok, Kanokwan Sriwattanapong, Vorasuk Shotelersuk, Thantrira Porntaveetus
pmc-11585565.description: Jalili syndrome, an autosomal recessive disorder causing cone-rod dystrophy and amelogenesis imperfecta, is a rare genetic disorder impacting visual and dental development. Missense variants (c.1474G > T and c.1475G > A) previously identified in patients with Jalili syndrome have been linked to functional impairment of CNNM4, however, the biological consequences of these pathogenic variants remain largely unexplored.

pmc-11603625.creator: Chaehyun Yum, Chaylen Andolino, Marjorie Anne Layosa, Michael Coleman, Stephen D. Hursting, Dorothy Teegarden

pmc-11647283.description: AimTo validate the diagnostic performance of a custom 96-micro-organism TaqMan PCR card (iCAM) for microbial keratitis (MK) from a single corneal epithelial sample.MethodsPatients over the age of 18 referred to Cambridge University Hospital with MK were recruited in this single-site prospective cohort study between September 2021 and January 2023.

pmc-12501203.title: Incentivizing teamwork to promote sustainability
pmc-12501203.creator: Kathleen Segerson
pmc-12501203.description: SignificanceEnvironmental economists have long studied the role of firm-level policies (e.g., regulations, taxes, subsidies) in promoting improvements in environmental protection and natural resource management. More recently, drawing from work on collective action and cooperation, economists have also studied policies based on group-level performance. In both cases, the focus has been on promoting individualistic effort rather than teamwork.

pmc-12509690.title: Uncovering the “Hidden” Relationship Between Old Age Assisted Dying and the Ancient Concept of Senicide
pmc-12509690.creator: Uwe Güth, Shaun McMillan, Edouard Battegay
pmc-12509690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectivesTo uncover a previously unrecognized link between the ancient cultural phenomenon of senicide, i.e. the practice of killing the elderly, and old age assisted dying (AD).MethodsUsing an interpretative-phenomenological approach, the background of both phenomena is reviewed.ResultsSenicide is based on utilitarian and altruistic judgements of the society and/or by older individuals themselves that they are no longer contributing members of the community. As a consequence, it is considered justifiable that the life of the elderly person should be intentionally ended.

pmc-12538276.title: Dynamics of protonated oxalate from machine-learned simulations and experiment: infrared signatures, proton transfer dynamics and tunneling splittings
pmc-12538276.creator: Valerii Andreichev, Silvan Käser, Erica L. Bocanegra, Madeeha Salik, Mark A. Johnson, Markus Meuwly
pmc-12538276.description: The infrared spectroscopy and proton transfer dynamics together with the associated tunneling splittings for H/D-transfer in oxalate are investigated using a machine learning-based potential energy surface (PES) of CCSD(T) quality, calibrated against the results of new spectroscopic measurements. Second order vibrational perturbation calculations (VPT2) very successfully describe both the framework and H-transfer modes compared with the experiments.

pmc-12549225.title: Lactiplantibacillus plantarum WB3801 and Lactiplantibacillus plantarum WB3808 Showed Antioxidant Effect and Anti-Apoptosis through Activation of the Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 Pathway in H2O2-Induced HT-29 Cells
pmc-12549225.creator: Kyung-Min Park, Yu-Rim Lee, Na-Kyoung Lee, Hyun-Dong Paik
pmc-12549225.description: Oxidative stress, primarily triggered by elevated levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) contributes to intestinal epithelial injury and apoptosis, and is closely associated with gastrointestinal disorders. In this study, we evaluated the cytoprotective effects of three Lactiplantibacillus plantarum strains (WB3801, WB3804, and WB3808) isolated from Korean kimchi against H2O2-induced oxidative stress in HT-29 cells.

pmc-12565384.title: Analysis of Factors Associated with Hypoglycemia in Patients with Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest Undergoing Targeted Temperature Management
pmc-12565384.creator: Wan Young Heo, Seok Jin Ryu, Dong Hun Lee, Byung Kook Lee, Yong Hun Jung, Kyung Woon Jeung, Enrico Baldi
pmc-12565384.description: Background: Patients with out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) are susceptible to hypoglycemia, which may worsen outcomes. Early identification of patients at risk is therefore essential. This study examined factors associated with hypoglycemia in OHCA survivors treated with targeted temperature management (TTM).

pmc-13280774.title: Organelle genome evolution in the early‐diverging brown algal lineage, Ishigeales
pmc-13280774.creator: Hayeon Hwang, Hocheol Kim, Seok‐Wan Choi, Hiroshi Kawai, Hwan Su Yoon
pmc-13280774.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The order Ishigeales is an early‐diverging lineage of brown algae that exhibits remarkable morphological diversity ranging from simple filamentous forms to robust terete and foliose thalli, which may reflect complex evolutionary histories in their organelle genomes. However, limited organellar genomic data for the Ishigeales, presently confined to Ishige okamurae, have hindered a comprehensive understanding of organelle genome dynamics in that order.

pmc-13371272.title: Outcomes and evolving surgical trends in inguinal hernia repair following prior urologic surgery: a 15-year single-center retrospective cohort study
pmc-13371272.creator: Hyo Seon Ryu, Eun Hae Cho, Ji-Seon Kim, Jung-Myun Kwak, Jin Kim, Se-Jin Baek
pmc-13371272.description: PurposePrevious urologic surgeries, including prostatectomy and cystectomy, are associated with an increased risk of inguinal hernia and may complicate subsequent hernia repair due to adhesions and altered pelvic anatomy. However, evidence regarding the optimal surgical approach and outcomes in this population remains limited and inconsistent.

pmc-13530857.title: When Myocardial Injury in Lupus Is Not Lupus: Probable Antimalarial‐Associated Cardiomyopathy Mimicking Lupus Myocarditis
pmc-13530857.creator: Diego Armando Pérez Covo, María Camila Bernal Beltrán, Diego Alejandro Ortega, Cristian Orlando Porras Bueno, Emilio José Juan Guardela, Carlos Hernán Calderón, Edward Andres Cáceres Méndez, Laura Valentina Omaña Álvarez, Alejandro Mariño Correa, Ángel Alberto García Peña
pmc-13530857.description: Antimalarial cardiotoxicity may mimic lupus myocarditis in systemic lupus erythematosus. We report a 53‐year‐old woman with chronic antimalarial exposure, myocardial injury, biventricular dysfunction, electrical abnormalities, low lupus activity, and no myocardial edema. Chloroquine withdrawal was followed by clinical improvement and left ventricular function recovery, supporting probable antimalarial‐associated cardiomyopathy.

pmc-13628758.title: Turkish adaptation of the Children’s Numeracy Interest Scale and its relationship with parental math involvement
pmc-13628758.creator: Hilal Karakuş Özkan
pmc-13628758.description: BackgroundChildren’s numeracy interest is increasingly recognized as an important affective dimension of early mathematical development. However, to the best of my knowledge, no empirical study has directly examined the association between parental math involvement and children’s numeracy interest in Türkiye, and no validated Turkish-language instrument for assessing this construct has been reported.

uslaw-usc-t49-s41707.title: 49 U.S.C. § 41707 — Incorporating contract terms into written instrument
uslaw-usc-t49-s41707.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s41707.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part A (Air Commerce And Safety); Subpart ii (Economic Regulation); Chapter 417 (Operations Of Carriers); Subchapter I (Requirements). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. To the extent the Secretary of Transportation prescribes by regulation, an air carrier may incorporate by reference in a ticket or written instrument any term of the contract for providing interstate air transportation.
